about_the_game:
Get in-game content for Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty®: Warzone™.

Pack includes:

  • Operator Skin

  • 3x Weapon Blueprints

  • GobbleGum

  • Emote

  • Finishing Move

  • Weapon Charm

  • Emblem

  • Loading Screen

  • Large Decal

Activision may update, replace, or remove this in-game content at any time.
